// diagnostic

E0213

A read or write window starts from something that is not a place.

What

A read or write window starts from something that is not a place.

Why

Only a name followed by fields, indexes, or one range has stable storage that can be accessed without copying.

Fix

Bind the call or temporary to a name first, then take the window from that name.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0213: tests/ui/place_window_requires_place.stderr.

Error [E0213]: a window must start from a place
  --> tests/ui/place_window_requires_place.jet:3:22
    |
  3 | fn run() { window :: &make()[0..1] }
    |                      ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: only a name followed by fields, indexes, or one range has stable storage to read or edit without copying
 Fix: bind the call or temporary to a name first, then take a window into that name
